name: Gol'Bolar Quarry
summary: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, troggs have driven the miners from the snowy hills of southeastern Dun Morogh. The Ironforge dwarves came for stone and ore, but now the dig lies quiet.

sections.title: A Quarry Under Siege
sections.body:
Ironforge dwarves opened Gol'Bolar Quarry southeast of Kharanos to draw stone and mineral wealth from the mountains. Their digging broke into underground warrens and brought a horde of hostile troggs into the open. The creatures soon drove out the miners.

The upper camp is now an embattled staging ground. Overseers, tradesfolk, and Prospector Gehn gather dwarven and gnomish recruits there to drive the troggs back and reclaim the pit.

faq.answer: Gol'Bolar Quarry is an open-pit mine in southeastern Dun Morogh. Ironforge dwarves keep it as a dig site and a small outpost with supplies and work for local adventurers.

faq.q: Why are there so many troggs here?
faq.answer: Dwarven miners dug too deeply and broke into tunnels inhabited by troggs. The creatures swarmed into the open pits and nearby mine shafts, forcing the miners back to the quarry's upper rim.
Prospector Gehn is a dwarven supervisor at the quarry camp. He oversees efforts to secure the dig site and offers bounties and tasks to adventurers willing to cull the troggs.

angles.text: Exposed rock tiers and nearby tunnels hold plentiful mineral veins. Entrenched troggs stand between you and the ore.
As a dwarf, clearing Gol'Bolar Quarry protects Ironforge's mountain resources and upholds clan pride. The dwarves cannot afford to let the troggs seize them.
